questions: For decode_cyclic, is the implementation required to be exactly encode_cyclic(encode_cyclic(s)) as shown in the reference, or can any correct decoding algorithm be used?
Does encode_cyclic shift groups of three characters by moving the first character to the end (left rotation) or the last character to the front (right rotation)?
How should groups of fewer than 3 characters be handled? Are they left unchanged, or should they be padded to length 3 before shifting?
If the input string is empty, should encode_cyclic return an empty string?
Is the grouping for encode_cyclic always non-overlapping and taken from left to right, starting at index 0?
For decode_cyclic, if the input string was not encoded by encode_cyclic, what behavior is expected? (e.g., raise error, return garbage, undefined)
Are characters limited to ASCII, or should Unicode characters (including multi-byte) be supported?
Should encode_cyclic and decode_cyclic handle newline characters or other control characters in the same way as regular characters?
